name: Northeast Avian Rescue (NEAR)
neighborhoods: Northeastern US incl. NYC; facility in East Greenbush, NY (near Albany), by appointment
region_note: COMPANION BIRDS (parrots, budgies, cockatiels, finches, doves, backyard poultry)
notes: All-volunteer 501(c)(3). Rescues, rehabilitates and rehomes abused/neglected/unwanted parrots and exotic birds. As a rule charges no adoption fee; adoption process is stringent. Member of Mayor's Alliance for NYC's Animals and Northeast Parrot Placement Cooperative. Open by appointment only.
